batch_record.reaction_description: Copper-catalyzed cycloaddition of benzyl azide and phenylacetylene to form 1,4-substituted 1,2,3-triazole
batch_record.raw_text: An equimolar mixture of benzyl azide and phenylacetylene was prepared in acetone at 0.25 M with copper-in-charcoal (Cu/C, 10 mol%). The mixture was heated by microwave irradiation at 150 C for 3 min. The 1,4-substituted 1,2,3-triazole was isolated in 94% yield.
